source_path_basis: All source report paths are relative to the original project root. They are provenance references, not public download links.
collection_method: Read only testsuite summary attributes and filesystem metadata; hash the original XML bytes with SHA-256. Do not export XML properties, logs, environment values or fixtures.
timestamp_interpretation: The five XML reports have no testsuite timestamp attribute. Exact execution start/end times are unavailable. File modification times are recorded as filesystem metadata and must not be treated as exact test execution times.
hash_interpretation: Hashes identify the audited local report bytes for later comparison. Without the original reports, they do not independently establish test execution or reproducibility.

scope: Server prices, request-content idempotency and stock reservation
Concurrent retry and last-stock contention using isolated MySQL fixtures
Payment/QC gates, ordered task events and failed-task retry
Ownership, college isolation, historical pagination and print-detail access
Marketing review invalidation and manual after-sales boundaries
suites.limits: The AI service is mocked. Device events and payments are simulations; this is not a real hardware or financial integration test.

scope: Explicit template and AI source labels
Strict JSON shape, duplicate/trailing-content rejection and length limits
Private-field exclusions and untrusted business data boundaries
Provider failure reporting without silent template substitution
suites.limits: Uses a mocked model client. Does not validate a live model, generation quality, paid inference or image/video generation.

scope: Password reset expiry, hashing, replacement and single/concurrent use
Old-session revocation and failed-delivery token revocation
Source-address rate limiting and legacy/admin access restrictions
suites.limits: Uses isolated database fixtures and mocked SMTP. Real email delivery was not verified.

scope: Regression tests for reused authentication and session infrastructure
suites.limits: Shared infrastructure tests, not six additional order-workflow tests. In-memory session concurrency does not establish full application throughput.

scope: Regression tests for reused request and shared AI capacity filtering
suites.limits: Filter-level regression only. Does not establish a production load, multi-node capacity or real model service rate.

historical_runner.mode: offline using an already cached provider
historical_runner.reason_documented: The default provider was not cached and the historical JDK encountered a TLS certificate-chain download error.

excluded_from_41: Frontend build, component compilation and TypeScript checks
Script-based frontend session, routing and history checks
Manual browser observations and print-preview inspection
not_verified: Live robot, vision, arm or other device actions
Real payment, refunds, carrier tracking or customs integration
Live model inference and generated image/video services
Physical printers and cross-browser paper settings
Production load, distributed deployment or independent reproducibility
publication_content: Only suite identities, counts, elapsed times, filesystem times, relative report paths, hashes and scope summaries are included. No account identifiers, credentials, personal records, XML environment properties or raw logs are included.
